thread:
Maria L.: FYI — we have ~28 onboarding tenants in EMEA affected by yesterday's auth spike that caused webhook retries and partial profile creation. sending a proactive note this morning. need help prioritizing renewals + enablement offers.
Ashwin R.: thanks. do we have the exact account list? I can pull renewal dates and ARR.
Jamie (CS Ops): I exported a list and pinned it to the thread. high-level: 28 tenants, 9 marked high-touch, 5 in trial, 4 have renewal in next 60d.
Olivia K.: rough ask from CS: one tailored email for high-touch, one templated for trials, plus a short FAQ / troubleshooting doc. Can Product provide a short RCA blurb we can copy? :pray:
Sam - Solutions: Product gave a timeline earlier — root cause was a race in the webhook ack path when downstream auth throttled. mitigation deployed (graceful backoff + bulk requeue).
incident-bot: mitigation-deploy completed by infra at 03:12 UTC — partial rollback not required.
Dylan T.: we should offer a live 30min enablement session for affected high-touch accounts. I can run two office hours: EMEA-friendly and APAC-friendly.
Maria L.: good. Jamie, can you annotate the list with renewal risk (high/medium/low)? we should surface to AMs ASAP.
Jamie (CS Ops): done. I added a column `risk_action` and flagged 7 high-risk accounts. shared the sheet link: https://redir.company/sheets/abC123
Ashwin R.: for comms cadence, propose: initial status email within 2 hours, follow-up with RCA + credit option within 48 hours, and optional office hours invite within 5 days. agree?
Olivia K.: agree. also ask AMs to note in their renewal tracker and offer a personal call. for trials we should extend trial by 7 days automatically and include a one-click opt-out.
Sam - Solutions: Product will provide: 1) 3-paragraph RCA (root cause, scope, resolution), 2) timeline bullets, 3) next-step mitigations and monitoring plan. ETA 6 hours.
Maria L.: can we draft the two email templates here? I'll start with the high-touch subject/body and Jamie you can adapt for trials.
Jamie (CS Ops): High-touch email draft:

Subject: Important update on upload/auth during onboarding — we're taking action

Hi {{first_name}},

We're reaching out about an issue during onboarding where some profile imports and webhook calls were delayed or retried. We've identified the cause and deployed fixes to stop retries and replay failed events. Our immediate actions:
• Fixed the webhook ack race that caused duplicate retries.
• Replayed ingest for affected tenants.
• Monitoring and alerting upgraded for the auth path.

Next steps: we'd like to schedule a short call to walk through the impact on your tenant and any gaps. As a gesture, we're offering a service credit or a free 1:1 enablement session.

Regards,
Redwood Customer Success

Maria L.: looks good, add a line about extended trial or credit options for trial accounts. also add a link to the FAQ.
Sam - Solutions: quick technical FAQ snippet you can append:

Q: What happened?
A: An intermittent race in the webhook acknowledgement path caused retries and partial writes for ~0.5% of onboarding events. Fixed and reprocessed.

Q: Do I need to do anything?
A: No manual action required. If you observe missing records, reply to this email and we'll prioritize a manual replay.

Olivia K.: can we include a one-click survey link in the follow-up RCA asking: "Did this issue materially impact your onboarding?" with answers: No / Minor / Significant. capture free-text feedback.
Dylan T.: I'll host office hours Wed 09:00 GMT and Thu 21:00 SGT. please add calendar invites once CS confirms accounts that want the session.
Maria L.: for renewals: flag the 4 accounts renewing in 60d and loop in their AMs with suggested bridge messaging and credit thresholds. Ashwin, can you recommend credit amounts by ARR tier?
Ashwin R.: yes — rough guidance: ARR <50k: $500 credit or 2 weeks free; 50k-250k: $1k or 1 month free; >250k: bespoke — discuss with sales. I'll DM finance to confirm.
Jamie (CS Ops): next ops items: 1) send initial status email (me) 2) attach RCA draft once Sam posts (Product) 3) schedule office hours invites (Dylan) 4) patch renewal tracker + AM outreach (Maria/Ashwin).
Maria L.: assigning owners in the sheet now. tagging @AMs channel when RCA is public.
Sam - Solutions: RCA draft uploaded: https://redir.company/rce/5823456789-rca-draft — includes timeline and mitigations.
Maria L.: perfect. final ask — please add a small blurb for public-facing status page (concise) and we can push an update.
Sam - Solutions: status blurb: "Resolved: Intermittent webhook retries affecting onboarding events. Full mitigation deployed; replays in progress. If you see missing data, contact support."
Olivia K.: I'll build the survey and the short FAQ page. Jamie and Maria, I'll send final email templates for sign-off in 3 hours.
Dylan T.: noted. I can accommodate recorded session link for customers who can't attend live.
Maria L.: thanks all. follow-up: update thread after initial send + attach any direct customer replies here for tracking. I'll also add a small summary for renewal committee. :white_check_mark:
